Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 1
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly identified the composer of "How Long Has This Been Going On?" as George Gershwin. The song was actually composed by Sam Cooke (with lyrics by his wife, Kathie Lee). George Gershwin died in 1937, long before Sam Cooke was born. This fundamental error in identifying the composer led to the entire subsequent investigation focusing on the wrong person, resulting in an incorrect answer about George Gershwin's place of death rather than Sam Cooke's.
